user.title: Resonus
user.description: The library is read from your music server; the phone is told what to play through its Companion app. The webhook identifier is the one Resonus shows under Settings › Home Assistant.

data_description.name: What the card is called: the room, or the device.
data_description.url: Navidrome, or the Navifind proxy in front of it.
data_description.notify_service: The phone's own, such as mobile_app_tablet.
data_description.webhook_id: Shown in Resonus, under Settings › Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: The music server did not answer, or refused these credentials.
error.unknown_notify_service: Home Assistant knows no such notify service. The Companion app on the phone makes one.

abort.already_configured: That phone is already set up.
